title: Kinematics Module 6 Lesson 3: Return to Origin Total Distance Integration custom practice

evidence_basis.originality_note: All prompts, numerical values and physical configurations are original; mapped Cambridge past-paper evidence informs cognitive demand and assessment structure only.

parts.prompt: A particle moves in a straight line starting from the origin $O$ at $t = 0$. Its velocity is given by $v(t) = 6 - 2t\text{ m s}^{-1}$ for $0 \le t \le 5$. Calculate the total distance travelled by the particle in the first $5\text{ s}$.
A particle starts from the origin $O$ at $t = 0$ and moves in a straight line with velocity $v(t) = 8t - 3t^2\text{ m s}^{-1}$. Find the non-zero time $t$ at which the particle returns to $O$.

A particle starts from the origin $O$ at $t = 0$ with velocity $v(t) = 8t - 3t^2\text{ m s}^{-1}$ and returns to $O$ at $t = 4\text{ s}$. Calculate the total distance travelled by the particle between $t = 0$ and $t = 4\text{ s}$.

A particle moves in a straight line with velocity $v(t) = 3t^2 - 12\text{ m s}^{-1}$ for $0 \le t \le 3$. Given that $s(0) = 0$, calculate the total distance travelled by the particle in the interval $0 \le t \le 3$.

A particle moves in a straight line from the origin $O$ with velocity $v(t) = 4 - 2\sqrt{t}\text{ m s}^{-1}$ for $t \ge 0$. Find the time $t$ when the particle reverses direction, and find its displacement from $O$ at this instant.

A particle moves in a straight line with acceleration $a(t) = 6 - 6t\text{ m s}^{-2}$. Given that the particle starts from rest at the origin ($u = 0, s = 0$ at $t = 0$), find the time $t > 0$ when it returns to the origin and its velocity at that instant.

questions.prompt: A particle $P$ moves in a straight line, starting from a fixed origin $O$ at $t = 0$. Its velocity $v\text{ m s}^{-1}$ at time $t\text{ s}$ is given by $v(t) = 12 - 3t^2$ for $0 \le t \le 4$.

parts.label: (a)
parts.prompt: Find the time $t_1$ at which $P$ comes to instantaneous rest, and find the displacement of $P$ from $O$ at this instant.

parts.label: (b)
parts.prompt: Find the displacement of $P$ at $t = 4\text{ s}$, and calculate the total distance travelled by $P$ during the interval $0 \le t \le 4$.

questions.prompt: A particle moves along a straight line such that its displacement $s\text{ m}$ from a fixed origin $O$ at time $t\text{ s}$ is given by $s(t) = 0.05(60t^2 - t^3)$ for $0 \le t \le 60$.

parts.label: (a)
parts.prompt: Find an expression for the velocity $v(t)$, and find the time at which the particle is at instantaneous rest.

parts.label: (b)
parts.prompt: Calculate the distance of the particle from $O$ when it comes to instantaneous rest, find the time at which it returns to $O$, and determine the total distance travelled by the particle before returning to $O$.

questions.prompt: A particle $P$ moves in a straight line passing through a fixed origin $O$. At time $t\text{ s}$, the acceleration of $P$ is given by $a(t) = 8 - 2t\text{ m s}^{-2}$. The particle passes through $O$ at $t = 0$ with velocity $u = -7\text{ m s}^{-1}$.

parts.label: (a)
parts.prompt: Obtain an expression for the velocity $v(t)$, and find the two values of $t$ at which $P$ is at instantaneous rest.

parts.label: (b)
parts.prompt: Find the displacement of $P$ at $t = 1$ and at $t = 7$, and calculate the distance travelled by $P$ between the two times of instantaneous rest.

questions.prompt: A particle $P$ starts from rest at the origin $O$ at $t = 0$ and moves in a straight line. Its velocity $v\text{ m s}^{-1}$ at time $t\text{ s}$ is given by $v(t) = 6\sqrt{t} - 2t$ for $t \ge 0$.

parts.label: (a)
parts.prompt: Find the time $t_1 > 0$ when $P$ comes to instantaneous rest, and calculate the maximum displacement of $P$ from $O$.

parts.label: (b)
parts.prompt: Find the time $T > 0$ at which $P$ returns to $O$, and calculate the total distance travelled by $P$ from $t = 0$ to $t = T$.

questions.prompt: A particle moves in a straight line from origin $O$. In the first phase ($0 \le t \le 4$), it accelerates from rest with constant acceleration $a = 3\text{ m s}^{-2}$. In the second phase ($t \ge 4$), its velocity is given by $v(t) = 12 - 3(t - 4)^2\text{ m s}^{-1}$.

parts.label: (a)
parts.prompt: Find the velocity and displacement of the particle at the end of the first phase at $t = 4\text{ s}$.

parts.label: (b)
parts.prompt: Find the time $t_{\text{stop}}$ at which the particle comes to instantaneous rest, and calculate the total distance travelled by the particle from $t = 0$ to $t_{\text{stop}}$.

questions.prompt: A particle $P$ moves in a straight line, starting from a fixed origin $O$ at $t = 0$. For $0 \le t \le 6$, its velocity $v\text{ m s}^{-1}$ is given by $v(t) = 2t(t - 3) = 2t^2 - 6t$. For $6 \le t \le 10$, its velocity is given by $v(t) = 54 - 3t$.

parts.label: (a)
parts.prompt: For the first phase $0 \le t \le 6$, find the time at which $P$ reverses direction, the minimum displacement of $P$ from $O$, the displacement of $P$ at $t = 6\text{ s}$, and the total distance travelled by $P$ in the first $6\text{ s}$.

parts.label: (b)
parts.prompt: For the second phase $6 \le t \le 10$, determine whether the particle reverses direction in this interval, find the displacement of $P$ at $t = 10\text{ s}$, and calculate the total distance travelled by $P$ across the entire $10\text{ s}$.

questions.prompt: A particle $P$ moves in a straight line such that its velocity $v\text{ m s}^{-1}$ at time $t\text{ s}$ is given by $v(t) = 0.12(t^2 - 10t + 16) = 0.12(t - 2)(t - 8)$ for $0 \le t \le 10$. The particle passes through the origin $O$ at $t = 0$.

parts.label: (a)
parts.prompt: Find the two times at which $P$ is at instantaneous rest, and calculate the displacement of $P$ from $O$ at both of these times.

parts.label: (b)
parts.prompt: Show that the particle passes through $O$ during the interval $2 < t < 8$, find the displacement of $P$ at $t = 10\text{ s}$, and calculate the total distance travelled by $P$ from $t = 0$ to $t = 10\text{ s}$.
